200.description: Ephemeral reminder wake stream (not revisioned task events)

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Exact built-in view preset. Structured filters are applied in addition.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Omitted = any; `-` = null; UUID = exact match.

parameters.name: tag_id
parameters.description: Single tag ID filter (AND-combined with `tag_ids` when both are set).

parameters.name: tag_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag IDs. Tasks must include every listed tag (AND).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive civil start date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to server-local today.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive civil end date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to `from`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Civil date filter (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to server-local today.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Optional project filter. Use `-` for unscoped slots.

lease_secs.description: Positive bounded TTL in seconds. Omitted uses the service default (90).

variables.description: Placeholder values keyed by name without braces. Bounded by request body size.

claim_attempt.description: Durable attempt generation that settle must echo exactly.

CommittedEventDto.description: Full committed event envelope used by mutations and SSE.

MutationResponse.description: Mutation responses carry exactly one committed event. `newly_committed` is never exposed.

sequence.description: Monotonic process-local sequence. Not a durable revision.

server_now.description: Server clock sample for the signal, RFC3339 UTC.

claim_attempt.description: Exact `claim_attempt` from the claim response for this occurrence.
